tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mngon rtogs

tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/ na mo badzra bhai ra wa ya/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor dbus/ /e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus/ /khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i nang*/ /thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus/ /yaṃ las rlung dkyil du ba'i mdog /de steng zla bar dhīḥyig las/ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser pod ral 'dzin/ /thugs kar nyi ma las 'od 'phros/ /sangs rgyas la sogs bkug nas bstim/ /'jam dpal gdan bcas nyi ma la/ /thim par dpag tshad brgya stong gi /tshad can nyi mar hūṃ mthing nag /de las rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs/ /me dang mtshon cha'i tsha tsha 'phros/ /sdang dang gdug can tshar bcad nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'jigs mdzad kyi/ /rnam par spyan drangs 'dres pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying pas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong*/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis sgra chen sgrogs/ /steng zhal dmar mo rgya chen bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad khro/ /g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ / gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing*/ /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ / g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar po rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud kha rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag po gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung btun shing dang*/ /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /dgra sta gdung mda' lcags kyu dang*/ /dbyug pa kha ṭwāṃ 'khor lo dang*/ /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang*/

/ral gri rde'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang*/ /ro ras skyais bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang*/ /'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyi rim bzhin su/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mong khyi lug lce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rin bzhin bya rgod dang*/ /'ug pa bya rog ne tso dang*/ khra dang khyung chen ri skeg bzhad/ /mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang*/ drag po gzhon nu gdong drug dang*/ /tshogs bdag nyi ma zla ba rnams/ /bsgyail nas kha bub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ /khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang*/ /sbrul nag chen po'i do shal can/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar mo glog ltar 'khyug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang*/ /khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang*/ /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyi mtshan/ /ling ga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i rol dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus la bzhugs/ /mig tu kṣiṃ dkar sa snying dngos/ /rna bar phyag rdor dzriṃ nag po/ /sna la khaṃ ser nam mkha'i snying*/ /lce la gaṃ dmar 'jig rten rje/ /dpral bar sgrib sel skaṃ ljang khu/ /lte bar kun bzang saṃ sngon po/ /dpral bar sku yi rdo rje oṃ/ /mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje āḥ /snying gar thugs kyi rdo rje hūṃ/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /'jigs mdzad rnam par spyan drangs te/ dgug dang gzhug dang bcings mnyes pas/

/bdag la gnyis su med par bstims/ /badzra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ hrīḥha bho mahā kro dha a gatstsha a gatstsha arma dha ra pū dza pra ti ghṛhnantu pra sa bha mi dhi man ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i bde gshegs kyis/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ nas/ nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ / nas/ gnas las byung ba'i sbyin par bya/ oṃ badzra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ mi bskyod rgyal pos dbu brgyan can/ /snying gar 'jam dpal gzhon nu bsam/ /de yi thugs kar rdo rje nag /hūṃ yig nag po 'bar bas mtshan/ /nam mkha' khyab pa lha mo'i tshogs/ sprul nas bdag la mchod par 'gyur/ /oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥhāḥ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ma ra ru pi ni dza dza: oṃ hrīḥha he phaṭa/ oṃ tibta lo tsa na/ bi kri tā na na mahā aṭṭa ṭṭa ha sa na di ne tibta ya swāhā/ oṃ bi kṛ tā na na duṣtaṃ satwa da ma ka ga ga ga oṃ mahā bhu ta a dhi pa ti i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa pa ta ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ / zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ / zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun can khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ya ma ra dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ ya kṣe yatstsha/ ni ra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥbi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya manta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ khams gsum dkyil 'khor rang la thim/ /bdag nyid 'od gsal du bsdus/ /slar yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad skur gyur ro/ / gong bzhin skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi go cha bkod/ /dge ba bsngo/ zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs blo dman gyi nyer mkho zhes bya ba 'di yang tā ra nā thas yar 'brog stag lung du sbyar ba'o//
//bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/ - PAGE 246 -- PAGE 247 - - PAGE 244 -
